name: Monocular Depth Predictor with Distribution Sampling
aliases: Depth Prediction via Discrete Distribution Sampling
definition: A neural network module that predicts a depth distribution for each ray from image features, sampling discrete depth values and probability density function (PDF) values to represent surface geometry.
summary: A neural network predicting depth distributions from image features, distinguishing itself by explicitly modeling multiple surfaces and using distribution sampling for stochastic depth estimation.
